{{Top|leg}}
A '''norrick loave''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> norrick loaves were among various exotic foods loaded aboard a [[Seltiss-2 caravel|Hutt caravel]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> at the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] [[berth Y-27]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]].<ref name="Scourge" /> for transport to Popara's [[Yacht/Legends|space yacht]] ''[[Imru Ootmian]]''.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />.
 
==Behind the scenes==
Norrick loaves first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'' by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> They later featured in Grubb's [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], an adaptation of ''Tempest Feud''.<ref name="Scourge" /> In both sources, norrick loaves are only mentioned in the plural.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /><ref name="Scourge" /> It is therefore unclear whether the singular form is "norrick loave" or "norrick loaf", with "loaf" being the standard English singular of "loaves". This article assumes the former.
